purpose: ZIP integrity, non-overwrite, numbering and respect for user deletions. Tests use isolated temporary HTML fixtures, never real user archives.

tests.name: a new HTML creates the first ZIP and verifies its actual extracted hash
an identical build creates no duplicate and never overwrites v1
a deleted current ZIP is not recreated for unchanged HTML
the next modification advances to v2 despite a deleted v1
old ZIP bytes remain unchanged after a further revision
deleting multiple ZIPs preserves their history and reserved numbers
an unregistered ZIP filename is never overwritten or reused
all deleted archive records retain their original hashes and descriptions
missing history blocks automatic recreation or numbering from scratch
